content: Ar hazna adaigoroya edde gunagar manuš okkol beggune Isar kalam funibolla Isar hãse aišše.
Henot Foroši okkole edde dórmiyo alem okkole monmonai endilla howa šuru goijje, "Ei manušwaye gunagar okkolore gose edde hitarar fũwati há fiya gore."
Isaye hetunot hitarare ei mesal kahanigan hoiye:

content.text: "Doro! Tũwarar butore hono ekzonottu ek šottuwa berasool ase. Zodi hinor butottu uggwa berasool hãzi zagoi. Toile ki aro nobboi noware maṛot raki, he uggware zetun tuwai no fa he foijjonto ki tuwaito no zaibo ne?
Ar hite zehon hiba tuwai faibo, hite kuši oi hibare handot tuli loibo.
Bade górot ai hitar fũwajja okkol edde ḍen gór ba gójjare ḍaki hoibo, 'Aiyo! Ãr fũwati kuši goro, kiyollahoile ãr hãzi gilgoide berasoolguwa tuwai faiyi.'
Ãi tũwarare hoir, ṭik hendilla, ekzon gunagar gunattu mon firaile behostot aro beši kuši oibo, zarattu monfira no fore, hendilla nobboi nozon forhesgaror babute heto beši kuši no oibo.
"Otóba hono ekzon mayafuwattu doššan rufar foiša ase, hibaye zodi ekkan hãzai fele, toile serag zalai gór kũsai zetun hiyan tuwai no fa, he foijjonto bala gori tuwai no saibo ne?
Toi hibaye zehon hiyan tuwai faibo, hibaye fũwajja okkolore, ḍen gór bam gójjare ḍaki hoibo, 'Aiyo! Ãr fũwati kuši goro, kiyollahoile hãzi gilgoide foišagan ãi abar tuwai faiyi.'
Ṭik hendilla, ãi tũwarare hoir, ekzon gunagar gunattu mon firaile Allar firista okkolor maze kuši aiye."
"Ekzonottu duizon morod fuwain aššil.
Šoṛo fuwawaye bafore hodde, 'Baba, šombottir ze borat ãr bagot fore, hiyan ãre difelo.' Henot hite hitar dui futor maze šombottigun borat gori diye.
Hotodin din bade he šoṛo fuwawaye hitar har šombotti besi ṭĩya loi ek duror dešot giyoi. Ar heṛe hite altifalti zibon haṛai hitar nizor ṭĩya foiša urai felaiye.
Hin horos goijja oiye, bade he dešot kub beši raṭ oiye. Henot hite obafot fora šuru goijje.
Toi hite zai he dešor ek girostorot sahara loiyegoi. He manušwaye hitare šuwor soraibolla hitar maṛot defeṛaiye.
Toi hite šuworor adar hái feṭ boraito saito, edde honokiye hitare hono kissu no dito.
"Hite zehon hitar nizor bul buzi faijje, hite hodde, 'Ãr bafor góror hoto muzur okkole beši beši hána far, kintu ãi eṛe bukke morir.
Ãi uṛi ãr Bafor heṛe zaiyum edde ãi hoiyumboi: O baf, ãi Allah edde tũwar berudde guna goijji.
Ãre tũi tũwar fuwa ho he zuiggota ãttu ar nai, kintu ãre tũi šude tũwar oinno muzur okkolor ḍoil gori ãre rako.'
Endilla hoi hite hitar bafor heṛe giye.
"Hite dure taite bafe hitare deki hitalla doyaye dil bori uiṭṭe. Ar hite fuwar hãse dũri zai, gola sai berai dori galot suma diye.
"Fuwaye hodde, 'O baf, ãi Allah edde tũwar berudde guna goijji. Ãre tũi tũwar fuwa ho he zuiggota ãttu ar nai.'
"Kintu hitar bafe hitar gulam okkolore hodde, 'Toratori barik kurutawa ano edde itare gat diyai do, õlot õri, ṭengot šendal findai do.
Ar boli muṭa goruror sowa ano edde hiba zorgorao. Aiyo, mela gori edde hafiya gori.
Kiyollahoile ãr ei fuwa mori gilgoi edde ehon zinda oiye. Hite hãzigilgoi edde abar fa giye.' Toi hitara mela edde há fiya šuru goijje.
"Hetunot ḍõr fuwawa bare ketit aššil. Hite aite aite zehon góror hãsa hãsi fõisse, hetunot tal bazana nasor abaz fuinne.
Toi hite ekzonore ḍak mari fusar goredde: Eṛe ki oiyede?
Hite hodde: Tor šoṛo bái firi aišše, hitare šušondane firai faiyede hetolla tor bafe boli muṭa gorur soware zorgoraiye.
"Henot he ḍõr báiye gušša oiye edde górot no goilto saiye. Toi hitar bafe góror baire zai hitare górot golaibolla fot dori hoiye.

Kintu hite bafore hodde, 'So, hara bosorṭiya ãi tũwalla gulami gori aiyir, ar hono din tũwar hokumor baire no zai. Hen abostat maze o tũi ãre fũwajja okkol loi kuši aiyaši goribolla hoi uggwa soolor so foijjonto no do.
Kintu ze fuwaye tũi dilade ṭĩya foiša beggun beššiya okkolor fise hossa gori felaiye, bade górot firi aišše, hitalla boli tũi muṭa goruwa zorgoraiyo!'
"Bafe hodde, 'O fut, tui hamiša ãr fũwati asos, ar zin ãttu ase hin tor.
Kintu ãrattu mela gori kušiaši goron zorulot, kiyollahoile tor ei bái mori gilgoi, abar zinda oiye. Hite hãzigilgoi, abar hitare fa giye.'"
